name: ApuInitialize
description: Initialize APU registers and call two five-entry index initializers.

name: InitializeAudioIndicesA
description: Fill 0015..0019 with 05,0B,11,17,1D; audio role from A01 caller.

name: ResetRetentionCheck
description: Check retained 0100 marker 68; otherwise load six bytes at 0300; call D2F7.

name: ResetRetainedDefaults
description: Six default bytes copied to 0300..0305; purpose unresolved.

name: HideAllSprites
description: Write F1 to every OAM Y byte in page 02.

name: HideSpritesFromIndex
description: For index 99 below 64, fill remaining OAM Y bytes with F3.

name: MapperWriteRetry
description: Write X to 8000 and A to 8001; retry if interrupt activity changes A6.

name: Bank0CEntry0
description: Map PRG0C at 8000, then tail-jump to 8000.

name: Bank0CEntry3
description: Map PRG0C at 8000, then tail-jump to 8003.

name: Bank0CEntry6
description: Map PRG0C at 8000, then tail-jump to 8006.

name: ResetEntry
description: Initialize hardware, bank mapping, selected RAM, PPU shadow and palette; jump to PRG0E CF50.

name: NmiEntry
description: Save A/X/Y, OAM DMA, PPU task, scrolling, optional IRQ setup, CHR writes, epoch increment and RTI.

name: DispatchPpuTask
description: Clear A0 using Y; select one of sixteen little-endian pointers with old A0 & 1E.

name: PpuTaskPointers
description: 16 little-endian pointers; indices are command&1E divided by 2.

name: PpuUpload27ViaStack
description: Stream 27 bytes from 0101..011B using PLA, restore SP; increment PPU by 32.

name: PpuTaskReturn
description: Shared RTS target; also fallthrough from A16.

name: UploadPalette32ViaStack
description: Read 0143..0162 through PLA; write 32 bytes to PPU; restore SP and service 06EE flag.

name: DisableRendering
description: Clear PPUMASK and shadows 5F/66; clear bit 1 of 4A.

name: FarCallViaA000
description: Save bank tags and registers, map 04EC into A000, call pointer 04EA, restore both PRG windows and result registers/flags.

name: FarCallIndirect
description: Indirect JMP through RAM 04EA/04EB; called with JSR to make the callee return to wrapper.

name: IrqEntry
description: Save A/X/Y in E2..E4; acknowledge/disable IRQ, enable again, dispatch through E5/E6.

name: IrqSplitPpuAddress
description: Timed PPU address/scroll writes indexed by 67; choose terminal split at F0 sentinel; share IRQ return.

name: IrqSplitScroll
description: Timed indexed scroll/control writes; select F83D on F0 sentinel.

name: IrqRestoreRegisters
description: Increment A6, restore Y/X/A from E4/E3/E2, RTI.

name: IrqSplitSwitchChr01
description: Timed split setting control, mask, address and CHR registers 0/1 to 0/2; set next IRQ low pointer 82.

name: InterruptVectors
description: Little-endian NMI, RESET and IRQ/BRK vectors in the fixed final bank.

name: ChrBankRegisters
description: MMC3 R0..R5 shadow values; each byte is a bank number

name: PpuCtrlShadowBase
description: First PPUCTRL shadow; indexed usage has unresolved array bounds

name: ScrollXShadowBase
description: First horizontal scroll shadow; indexed bounds unresolved

name: ScrollYShadowBase
description: First vertical scroll shadow; indexed bounds unresolved

name: PpuMaskShadowBase
description: First PPUMASK shadow; indexed bounds unresolved

name: SplitPpuMaskShadow
description: Mask used by terminal split handler

name: IrqSplitIndex
description: Index advanced by IRQ split handlers

name: NmiSplitSelector
description: Selects NMI scroll/control indexing path

name: SplitControlIndexBase
description: Index source; table extent unresolved

name: IrqLatchBase
description: First IRQ count/latch byte; indexed bounds unresolved

name: NmiChrStartIndexShadow
description: Receives X before NMI CHR writes; broader role unresolved

name: NmiIrqSetupFlag
description: Controls NMI IRQ setup; tested values 0 and 1 only

name: OamUsedSpriteIndex
description: Index used to hide remaining sprites; valid count below 64

name: PpuUploadAddress
description: Little-endian upload destination used by 27-byte stack transfer

name: NmiPpuTaskCommand
description: Command masked with 1E for pointer-table index; consumed by NMI

name: MapperInterruptEpoch
description: Incremented by NMI/IRQ; cleared and compared by mapper writer

name: IrqHandlerSource
description: Little-endian source copied to E5/E6 during NMI IRQ setup

name: IrqSavedA
description: IRQ A save slot

name: IrqSavedX
description: IRQ X save slot

name: IrqSavedY
description: IRQ Y save slot

name: SharedDispatchPointer
description: Shared little-endian PPU-task/IRQ target; lifetime-dependent meaning

name: NmiSavedA
description: NMI A save slot

name: NmiSavedX
description: NMI X save slot

name: NmiSavedY
description: NMI Y save slot

name: ResetRetainedMarker
description: Value 68 suppresses retained default copy; not cleared by RESET

name: PpuUpload27Buffer
description: 27 bytes streamed using temporary SP=00; page is also CPU stack

name: PaletteUploadBuffer
description: 32 bytes streamed using temporary SP=42; page is also CPU stack

name: TransferSavedStackPointer
description: Real SP saved during PPU stack-based transfers

name: OamDmaBuffer
description: CPU-side OAM buffer; one sprite per four bytes, Y at multiples of 4

name: ResetRetainedBlock
description: Not cleared on reset; first six bytes defaulted when 0100 differs from 68; purpose unresolved

name: FarCallTarget
description: Little-endian target CPU address

name: FarCallTargetBankA000
description: MMC3 R7 bank value for far call

name: FarCallSavedBankA000
description: Bank identity read from BFFF

name: FarCallSavedBank8000
description: Bank identity read from 9FFF

name: PaletteUploadPostFlag
description: If initially nonzero, palette upload replaces with FF; wider meaning unresolved
